text: O'Neills Irish International Sports Company is owned by its managing director, Anthony Towell.
short: Owned by its managing director, Anthony Towell

source.name: Rugby.ro: ROMÂNIA: După o pauză de 15 ani, O’Neills va fi din nou sponsor tehnic al echipei naționale de rugby / FOTO
source.quote: în prezența domnului Anthony Towell, Managing Director și proprietar al companiei
source.note: Translation: 'in the presence of Mr Anthony Towell, Managing Director and owner of the company' — the company being O'Neills Irish Sport, at the signing of the kit partnership at its Giurgiu (Romania) factory. The same article says O'Neills was founded in 1918 and is Ireland's largest sportswear manufacturer.
